slice.title: Save slice · {title}
slice.hint: A slice is a cross-section of the body, viewed from below: the patient's right side is on the left of the image, the back is at the bottom. Slices in a series run from top to bottom: the first ones near the neck, the last ones near the abdomen. In the “Lung” window, air is black, the lungs look like two dark wings with white branching vessels, and the heart and spine are light. A lesion in the lung is a round light spot on a dark background, usually 5–15 mm. Segments: S4/S5 is the middle of the right lung, closer to the heart; S7 is at the bottom of the left lung. Move the slider until the lungs fill most of the image, and ask the AI about anything unclear.
slice.label: Caption (what's on the slice)
slice.note: The image will be added to the study files; “Ask AI” and “AI comment” will see it. The model sees only this slice, not the whole study.
